title: EFC Ontological Foundations v1.0: The Co-Primary Structure
abstract: Tests three hypotheses for energy-entropy primacy within Energy-Flow Cosmology: H1 (energy-flow primacy), H2 (entropy primacy), and H3 (co-primary structure). H1 and H2 each fail circularity tests. Only H3, the co-primary structure, passes all consistency checks. Energy-flow and entropy are co-primary, with differentiation occurring at the Planck transition from a pre-geometric potential.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Pre-Planck to post-Planck; foundational for all EFC architecture

key_results: H1 (energy-flow primacy) fails circularity test: entropy required to define energy flow
H2 (entropy primacy) fails circularity test: energy flow required to define entropy changes
H3 (co-primary structure) passes all consistency checks
Energy-flow and entropy are co-primary, differentiating at the Planck transition
Pre-Planck phase described as undifferentiated pre-geometric potential
